biggest_catch: REJECT — there is no standalone 'Toluna Games' product: games are a minor side activity (a spin-the-wheel and simple arcade games) inside Toluna's survey platform, and the company publishes no payout terms for the games at all — no per-game amounts, no game-specific minimum, no published conversion.
catches: No standalone Toluna Games app or page exists — searches surface only the Toluna survey platform (toluna.com) and review blogs describing in-platform games.
The games lane pays random, unspecified amounts: third parties report 'up to 2,500 points (less than $1) per game' or '80–1000 points' for the spin-the-wheel — none of it from the company.

Toluna's published redemption thresholds (30,000 points = $10, PayPal in £35 installments) are platform-level survey-program figures reported by third parties, not official games payouts — the route as catalogued ('Toluna Games' as a way to earn) has no official payout terms of its own.
Toluna the company is real (Paris-based research company, founded 2000, 21M+ members) — this is a product-existence/terms-concreteness rejection, not a legitimacy rejection.
The games are deliberately the lowest-yield activity on the platform; surveys are the documented earning lane, which is a different route.
Same checklist bar as the Nielsen rejection (R0213): legit company, no concrete payout in official terms for this route — stays unverified; rejection logged rather than forcing a positive.

c1.evidence: Toluna is a real operating market-research company (Paris-based, founded 2000); the Toluna Influencers platform and mobile app are live. The route subject — a distinct games-earning product called 'Toluna Games' — does not exist as a verifiable product.

c2.evidence: FAIL — no concrete payout terms published by the company for the games activity: no per-game amounts, no game-specific minimum, no published points-to-cash conversion for games. All figures are third-party estimates.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee — the Toluna platform is free to join.

c4.evidence: FAIL — no official source for a 'Toluna Games' route with concrete payout figures was obtainable; games are documented only in third-party reviews.

eligibility: Toluna membership required (free); games available to members in-app/on-site.
notes: If Toluna ever publishes official terms for its games activity (per-game points, game-specific redemption), this could be re-checked — but it would still be a sub-activity of the survey platform, not a distinct route. The games figures in review blogs (spin-the-wheel 80–1000 points) are explicitly described as random amounts.

s1.note: Toluna membership is free; games are a side activity inside the platform.

s2.note: No participation fee; game payouts are random and unpublished by the company.

s3.note: Third parties report game payouts under $1 per game; nothing official on timing.

s4.note: No weasel-word analysis performed — the route fails on a nonexistent product with no official terms.

s5.note: FAIL — no official Toluna Games product page or terms exist.

s6.note: FAIL — concrete steps with official figures cannot be stated.

s7.note: No official source with concrete payout figures was obtainable.
